scripts.bundle: esbuild src/service-worker.ts src/options.ts src/popup.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=dist && cp manifest.json options.html options.css popup.html popup.css dist/ && rm -rf dist/_locales dist/res && cp -R _locales dist/ && cp -R res dist/
scripts.package:crx: npm run bundle && mkdir -p release && crx3 -p release/bizneo-reminders.pem -o release/bizneo-reminders.crx -z release/bizneo-reminders.zip dist
